```sql
SELECT SUM(ch.population)
FROM main.country_history ch
JOIN main.country c ON ch.code = c.Code
WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia'
  AND ch.effective_month = '2026-05'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM main.gov_temporal_binding tb
    JOIN main.gov_measure_def md ON tb.metric_id = md.metric_id AND tb.leg = md.leg
    WHERE md.measure = 'population'
      AND tb.graph_version = (
        SELECT MAX(graph_version) 
        FROM main.gov_temporal_binding 
        WHERE '2026-08-15' >= effective_month
      )
  )
```
